standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 6262-6268)

standard_prerequisites.name: The existence of a flat finitely presented cover of the base over which the gerbe acquires a section
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 6269-6278)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the base change on which the presentation is available.

core_obligations: Base change to get a section: since the gerbe morphism is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, there is a flat finitely presented cover of the base over which the gerbe acquires a section (proof lines 6261-6275)
Apply the section result: over that cover the base-changed gerbe is the quotient stack of the cover by the automorphism group of the section (proof lines 6276-6283)
proof_roadmap: gerbe 态射满、平坦、局部有限表现 ⇒ 存在基的满平坦局部有限表现覆盖 Y' → Y 使 X ×_Y Y' 有截面。
由「有截面的 gerbe 是商栈」即得 X ×_Y Y' = [Y'/G]。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a gerbe over an algebraic space becomes a quotient stack after a flat finitely presented base change of the base (author lemma at source lines 6247-6259, label lemma-local-structure-gerbe). The proof (source lines 6261-6284) uses the surjectivity flatness and finite presentation of the gerbe morphism to find a cover over which a section exists and applies the section result (proof lines 6261-6283). The construction of the cover with a section is the substance. H3.
